```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Job data
jobs = {
    "0": {"processing_time": 28, "due_date": 339, "weight": 9},
    "1": {"processing_time": 24, "due_date": 284, "weight": 5},
    "2": {"processing_time": 23, "due_date": 431, "weight": 7},
    "3": {"processing_time": 62, "due_date": 168, "weight": 5},
    "4": {"processing_time": 37, "due_date": 380, "weight": 9},
    "5": {"processing_time": 47, "due_date": 409, "weight": 4},
    "6": {"processing_time": 8, "due_date": 283, "weight": 4},
    "7": {"processing_time": 82, "due_date": 492, "weight": 6},
    "8": {"processing_time": 33, "due_date": 238, "weight": 4},
    "9": {"processing_time": 77, "due_date": 263, "weight": 3},
    "10": {"processing_time": 35, "due_date": 170, "weight": 6},
    "11": {"processing_time": 84, "due_date": 194, "weight": 1},
    "12": {"processing_time": 10, "due_date": 387, "weight": 7},
    "13": {"processing_time": 68, "due_date": 372, "weight": 9},
    "14": {"processing_time": 100, "due_date": 344, "weight": 10}
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Sets and parameters
n = len(jobs)
job_ids = list(jobs.keys())

# Variables
C = model.addVars(job_ids, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")  # Completion times
T = model.addVars(job_ids, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")  # Tardiness
x = model.addVars(job_ids, job_ids, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")  # Sequencing variables

# Objective: Minimize the total weighted tardiness
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[j]["weight"] * T[j] for j in job_ids), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints
# Completion time constraints
for j in job_ids:
    model.addConstr(C[j] >= jobs[j]["processing_time"] + gp.quicksum(jobs[i]["processing_time"] * x[i, j] for i in job_ids if i != j))

# Tardiness constraints
for j in job_ids:
    model.addConstr(T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[j]["due_date"])

# Sequencing constraints
for i in job_ids:
    for j in job_ids:
        if i != j:
            model.addConstr(x[i, j] + x[j, i] == 1)

# Solve the model
model.optimize()

# Extract the solution
sequence = sorted(job_ids, key=lambda j: C[j].X)
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Output the result
import json
print(json.dumps({"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}))
```
